summary: The uncommitted M8 change (88 modified, 21 new files, nothing staged or committed; HEAD is a7988f9, the user's own .prettierignore commit pushed before the M8 task began, on top of b107ddc) covers the brief and plan.md. Profiles at /u/[username] show a results table with final rank and won-drawn-lost record, plus activity: upcoming registrations and organizations. Both are gated by showResults/showActivity in services/profiles.ts, so hidden data never reaches page data, and the owner sees everything with a 'Hidden from others.' note. Records count only completed matches. The Steam cache stores IStoreService/GetAppList in steam_apps. Once the list is a day old, the next search refreshes it in the background; the very first search waits. Refreshes are guarded by a shared in-process promise and a cross-process attempted_at claim, which also gives the 10-minute back-off. Each request times out after 15 s, the list is swapped in one transaction so a failed refresh keeps the old cache, the key is never logged, and search is ranked. tournaments.game { appId, name, headerImage } comes from a drizzle-generated migration 0005, and headerImage is always built on the server. The picker is an accessible combobox with a no-JS form path and is hidden without STEAM_API_KEY. The game shows on the tournament header, in TournamentList and on the org page. REST has the game field and GET /api/v1/steam/apps. No CSP exists, and the M9 note covers img-src. All six M6 and four non-CSRF M7 findings are fixed. The i18n sweep adds messages.spec.ts, the a11y checklist adds contrast.spec.ts, and PLAN.md (M8 ✅ with Done when and notes) and README (Steam key, profiles, adding a locale) are updated. The CSRF setup is unchanged, and the code follows the existing style. I re-ran check (0 errors/0 warnings), lint, test:unit (37 files/436 tests) and the full e2e suite (16 passed, with no Steam refresh by the e2e server). One major issue: routes.db.spec.ts runs real routes that use the global steamApps singleton. With STEAM_API_KEY in .env, as the new docs suggest, those tests download Steam's app list with the real key and then fail. I reproduced this with a dummy key and outbound traffic blocked. Two minor test gaps: the picker-hidden-without-key path and handleError. Separately, a pre-existing issue outside M8 needs the user's decision: Vitest inlines .env's DATABASE_URL into $app/env/private, so the db tests run against and truncate the developer's 'local' database, not tournament_test. Full review: .agents/tasks/m8-profiles-steam-polish/2026-10-30-224859-review.md (also review.md).

findings.detail: Two tests only pass while the singleton `steamApps` (services/steam.ts, built from `$app/env/private` STEAM_API_KEY) is disabled: PATCH `game: { appId: 20 }` → 422 and GET /steam/apps?q=x → []. In Vitest, `$app/env/private` is inlined from vite.loadEnv, which reads .env, .env.local, .env.test and the shell; the db project's test.env doesn't reach it. So once a developer puts STEAM_API_KEY in .env, as .env.example and the README now suggest, these tests trigger an awaited full IStoreService/GetAppList download with the real key (the cache is never-fetched after resetDatabase), and then both assertions fail: real games match 'x' and app 20 exists. Reproduced with STEAM_API_KEY=review-dummy and outbound traffic blocked by a proxy: the run wrote a steam_app_list claim row (attempted_at = run time, fetched_at null). This breaks the 'no test can reach Steam' requirement. Fix: in routes.db.spec.ts, replace the singleton with a disabled instance, e.g. `vi.mock('#lib/server/services/steam.ts', async (original) => ({ ...(await original()), steamApps: createSteamApps({ apiKey: undefined }) }))`. Also add a setupFiles entry for the db Vitest project that stubs globalThis.fetch to reject, so no db test can open a network connection whatever the environment.

The FEAT-001 criterion 'without STEAM_API_KEY the General tab shows no picker and a stored game still shows' has no test. The e2e server always runs with 'e2e-dummy-key', and no db spec loads this page. Add a db spec that calls this `load` with a fake event, as matches.db.spec.ts does for the room load. With a stored game it should assert `steam: null` and that `game` is passed through. Use the same disabled-steamApps mock as the major finding, so the test doesn't depend on the environment.

The new `handleError` changes the message every unknown URL and unexpected error shows. SvelteKit's 'Not Found' becomes m.error_not_found() ('Page not found'), and unknown errors are logged and answered with m.error_title(). No unit or e2e test exercises any branch. Add an e2e that visits a missing route and asserts 404 with 'Page not found', or a unit test that calls handleError with kind 'app', 'framework' (404 and 500) and 'unknown'.

Pre-existing and outside M8; needs the user's go-ahead before changing the test setup. db/index.ts reads DATABASE_URL from `$app/env/private`, which in Vitest is inlined from .env (postgres://…/local). db-setup.ts migrates project.config.env.DATABASE_URL (tournament_test). Confirmed: after a normal `vitest --project db` run, the `local` database held that spec's rows timestamped at the run, and tournament_test was empty. Every `pnpm test:unit` therefore truncates the developer's local database, and with M8's resetDatabase that includes the local Steam cache. One option (verify first): a committed .env.test, which Vite loads in Vitest's 'test' mode over .env, setting DATABASE_URL to the tournament_test URL and an empty STEAM_API_KEY. Keep TEST_DATABASE_URL working for CI.
